text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual PM2.5 emissions from wildfires 2003 to 2025
PM2.5 emissions represent the quantity of fine particulate matter (diameter less than 2.5 micrometers) released
by wildfires, in tonnes. The 2026 data is incomplete and was last updated 28 August 2026.
